rationale: manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=iter-2 EXPLORATORY: headline lever pwls_gamma 1.0->0.5. iter-1 gamma=1.0 hr=0.1335 sits BELOW plain-TV peak hr=0.2085 (same protocol, search-20260619-01) => Manhart full ray-weighting W=exp(-1.0*p) over-downweights high-attenuation rays at this Mayo noise level, blurring the data residual vs plain TV. gamma=0 is exactly plain TV; gamma=0.5 is the midpoint, halving the downweighting to recover the lost data-fidelity while keeping SOME statistical weighting. ONE knob: all else fixed (weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=200, tv_lr=0.01, tv_clip_max=0.05). Maps whether gamma monotonically degrades or has an interior optimum between 0 (plain) and 1 (Manhart). Budget: iter-1 ran 1159.6s<1200s., pwls_gamma=0.5
